title.en: Where the Blood Goes After a Meal

text.zh: 一顿饭下肚，腹腔里的血流会明显增多。多出来的这部分不是白给的——它要负责把刚吸收的东西运走。
text.en: After a meal, blood flow through the abdomen rises sharply. That extra share is not a gift: its job is to carry away everything that has just been absorbed.

text.zh: 第一批岔口开在胃的上方。往右去的一支管肝和胆，往左去的那支沿着胰腺上缘蜿蜒着走向脾——腹腔里最弯的一条动脉就是它。
text.en: The first junctions open above the stomach. The branch heading right serves liver and gallbladder; the one heading left snakes along the top edge of the pancreas towards the spleen — the most tortuous artery in the abdomen.

text.zh: 再往下两个岔口铺开一整张扇面，钻进吊着肠子的那层膜里。吃进去的东西走到哪一段，血就在哪一段最忙。
text.en: Two junctions further down spread into a whole fan, threading into the membrane that slings the intestines. Wherever the meal has reached, that is the stretch where the blood is busiest.

text.zh: 那层膜本身也值得看：扇形的双层，一边固定在腹后壁上，一边散开去吊住每一段肠子。
text.en: The membrane itself is worth a look: a double sheet fanning out, fixed along the back wall at one edge and spreading at the other to carry every loop of bowel.

text.zh: 左上腹这个器官接的是同一批血，但它做的事完全不同：它在血里挑拣，把该退役的红细胞拦下来。
text.en: This organ high on the left takes blood from the same supply, but does something else entirely with it: it sorts, holding back the red cells that have served their time.

text.zh: 再往外还有一层更大的，衬着整个腹腔的内壁，又翻回来包住器官。器官不是堆在腔里的，是被这层膜兜住的。
text.en: Outside that lies a larger one still, lining the whole cavity and folding back to wrap the organs. They are not piled loose in there; this sheet holds them.

text.zh: 关键在回程。腹腔里这几条静脉不直接回心脏，它们先并成一股，把血整批送进肝——先过一道检查，才准进入全身。
text.en: The twist is in the return. These abdominal veins do not head straight for the heart; they merge into a single trunk and deliver the whole load to the liver first — inspection before release.

text.zh: 旁边这一对就不用绕。肾出来的血直接汇进下腔静脉往上走——同在腹腔，待遇完全不一样。
text.en: The pair beside them skip that detour. Blood leaving the kidneys goes straight into the great vein and heads upwards — same abdomen, completely different treatment.

text.zh: 脊柱右侧还藏着一条备用线，它把上下两条大静脉暗中接在一起。主路被压住时，血就从这里绕过去。
text.en: A spare line hides along the right of the spine, quietly joining the upper and lower great veins. When the main road is squeezed shut, blood detours through here.

text.zh: 所以消化道的血液自成一套回路：动脉照常送来，静脉却先交给肝。全身只有这一段，血在回家路上被拦了一次。
text.en: So the gut runs a circuit of its own: arteries deliver as usual, but the veins report to the liver first. Nowhere else in the body is blood stopped and checked on its way home.
